style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, bright even lighting, ancient Greek Archaic-period clothing. Background must be pure white.
avoid_en: text, letters, logos, modern buildings or clothes, nudity, bare chest, blood, a second separate person

pan.desc_en: Pan, the ancient Greek god of shepherds and wild mountains of Arcadia, a lively wiry man about 35 years old with two small curved goat horns on his head, pointed ears, a short dark brown beard, sharp amber eyes, the lower body of a goat with shaggy dark brown fur legs and cloven hooves, wearing a short brown fawn-skin tunic that fully covers his chest and shoulders tied with a leather cord (Archaic Greek period), a panpipe of seven reeds (syrinx) hanging from his belt, no armor, no crown
